n_fits.description: replication fits in the final result (planned plus extension)

n_fits_planned.description: replication fits planned before the extension step

n_fits_extension.description: fits of the rule's extension step

n_bracketed_before.description: readings bracketing b* before the extension step

n_extension_readings.description: readings that needed the extension step

n_reached.description: readings that reach b* in the final result

unreached_pair.description: the reading that did not replicate the crossing: pair

unreached_bmax.description: ... highest new-seed mean batch score reached

plain_diff_min.description: plain scVI batch score, seeds 0-4 minus sweep seeds 100-102, 13 ranked pairs: min

n_from_plain.description: readings interpolated from plain scVI at seeds 0-4 (lower point strength 0)

n_from_plain_passed.description: ... of which the new-seed mean at the lower refitted strength already reached b*

absdiff_median.description: |replication - sweep| biology at b*, readings that reach b*: median

pair_mad_min.description: per-pair mean |replication - sweep| (pairs with six readings): min

n_top_same.description: pairs whose first-ranked penalty is the same

n_rank_same.description: readings with the same rank in sweep and replication

n_rank_within1.description: readings whose rank moved by at most one place

n_gaps_kept.description: large gaps whose sign is kept (raw reading)

close_gap_pair.description: large gap closest to flipping: pair

p_pair.description: one-sided sign-flip p over pairs (the rule's test)

p_pair_hits.description: patterns reaching the observed mean, over pairs

p_task.description: sensitivity: one-sided sign-flip p, signs flipped per task (both decoders together)

p_task_hits.description: patterns reaching the observed mean, per task

n_tasks_tau_sum_positive.description: tasks whose summed tau-b is positive

near_ties_within.description: near-ties whose replication difference stays within +/-0.04

p_slope.description: sign-flip p over pairs, slope-adjusted reading

before_n_gaps_defined.description: before the extension step: large gaps with both readings

before_undefined_pair.description: ... the pair of the gap that could not be read

before_mean_tau.description: before the extension step: mean tau-b

before_p.description: before the extension step: sign-flip p over pairs

before_agree.description: before the extension step: rule met as computed
